items.title: Joe Watkins Interview, 1960-03-16
items.q: the most I knew about Elmer was when he was playing with us. I never met him before until he joined up with us.

ctx.x: Yeah. Well, I was going to ask a little bit, we only have another minute left, about Elmer Talbert. If you can tell us anything about him since he's not here to talk for himself.
Well, the most I knew about Elmer was when he was playing with us. I never met him before until he joined up with us.
Well, I thought he came from uptown there too. Maybe you'd know him.
